entries.summary: Default Whisper for everyday use: quantized weights, strong English and European accuracy with decent Chinese and mixed-language results, light enough for most Macs. Runs on the Neural Engine through WhisperKit.
entries.attribution: Whisper large-v3-turbo by OpenAI (MIT); CoreML conversion by Argmax (MIT).

entries.summary: Full-precision Whisper Turbo: slightly more accurate than the Standard variant on difficult audio, but uses noticeably more memory and disk and takes longer to load the first time.
entries.attribution: Whisper large-v3-turbo by OpenAI (MIT); CoreML conversion by Argmax (MIT).

entries.summary: NVIDIA’s fast multilingual Parakeet (0.6B) for European languages: very fast on the Neural Engine with strong accuracy, punctuation and capitalization included, but it knows no Chinese, Japanese, or Korean. Batch only.
entries.attribution: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 by NVIDIA (CC-BY-4.0); CoreML conversion by FluidInference.

entries.summary: NVIDIA’s Parakeet Unified (0.6B) for English: punctuation and capitalization built in, one checkpoint for both batch and live streaming text, fast on the Neural Engine. Best pick for English-only dictation.
entries.attribution: Parakeet Unified EN 0.6B by NVIDIA (CC-BY-4.0); CoreML conversion by FluidInference.

entries.languageSummary: 64 languages incl. Chinese, Japanese, Korean; auto-detect
entries.summary: NVIDIA’s Nemotron 3.5 streaming model (0.6B, 2.2 s chunks): live partial text and batch from one pipeline, punctuation and capitalization built in, Chinese and Japanese on the Neural Engine. The 64-language list is the model’s own; accuracy is below Whisper on most of them, so keep Whisper for languages it lacks.
entries.attribution: Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming 0.6B by NVIDIA (OpenMDW-1.1); CoreML conversion by FluidInference.

entries.languageSummary: Chinese, English, Cantonese, Japanese, Korean; auto-detect
entries.summary: FunAudioLLM’s SenseVoice Small (234M): the whole utterance in one non-autoregressive pass, punctuation and capitalization built in, Chinese punctuation written as ，。 and numbers as digits. Fastest of the on-device models on the Neural Engine; a larger fp32 graph is used automatically for the other compute-unit choices. Five languages with a selectable hint; keep Whisper for the rest.
entries.attribution: SenseVoice Small by FunAudioLLM / Alibaba (FunASR Model Open Source License 1.1); CoreML conversion by FluidInference.

entries.summary: FunASR’s Paraformer-large (220M): the Mandarin accuracy pick (2.12 % CER on AISHELL-1), one non-autoregressive pass per utterance, 222 MB. Writes no punctuation and no digits (三十, not 30); English words inside Mandarin speech come through. Runs on the Neural Engine only — GPU + CPU and CPU only are refused. Keep Whisper for every other language.
entries.attribution: Paraformer-large by Alibaba DAMO Academy / FunASR (Apache-2.0); CoreML conversion by FluidInference.

entries.summary: NVIDIA’s Parakeet Realtime EOU (120M): the smallest model here, 224 MB, built for live text — a new partial every 320 ms of speech. English only, lowercase, no punctuation (4.9 % WER on LibriSpeech test-clean). Its end-of-utterance signal is reported but never stops a recording. Keep Whisper for punctuation or any other language.
entries.attribution: Parakeet Realtime EOU 120M by NVIDIA (NVIDIA Open Model License); CoreML conversion by FluidInference.

entries.summary: Apple’s own speech-to-text model, built into macOS 26 and later. Nothing to download from KVoice: macOS fetches and keeps the assets for each language you dictate in (Install adds the current transcription language). Live text while you speak, punctuation and capitalization, and the Dictionary as recognition hints. Auto-detect means your Mac’s language. Accuracy is Apple’s, not measured against Whisper.
entries.attribution: Speech framework by Apple; assets managed by macOS.
